descriptionPlain: CRED is hiring a cloud security engineer in Bengaluru.

lists.content:
• 2-6 years of experience in information security
  • Fundamentals in computer networks, Linux, containers and secure cloud architecture
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Go or Bash
  • Hands-on cloud security experience in AWS, GCP or Azure
  • Building and automating custom security tools
  • Understanding of microservices, CI/CD pipelines and securing containerized workloads
  • Least privilege, defence-in-depth and zero trust
  • Vulnerability management, patching cycles and CVSS
